title: REPLAY: Hegseth warns of 'Islamist threat' at 9/11 25th anniversary commemorations
summary: US defense secretary Pete Hegseth delivered remarks at a ceremony at the Pentagon on Friday on the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks.
